pairs.why: Both hatboxes are nearly identical in their soft matte-satin finish, rounded lid and lighting, so neither is clearly closer to the real cards.
A's rope handle is smoother and less fibrous, which fits the real cards' smooth but not ultra-smooth finish better than B's more textured twist.
B has a stray little gold crown on the lid that doesn't belong on this object, while A is clean and built like a plausible hatbox.
B's proportions and thinner rope look a little tidier and closer to the real cards' clean toy-like build, though the two are nearly identical.
B again has a stray crown emblem on the lid, while A shows the same finish without the out-of-place detail.
The two drawings are almost indistinguishable in rendering, color, light and construction.
A's lid has slightly softer rounded shading and its rope is a touch less fibrous, which is marginally closer to the real cards' smooth satin look.
Both share the same soft lighting, matte-satin finish and shape, with no meaningful difference against the real cards.
